planner.title: Planner workspace
planner.externalHint: External vendor — invite them to Tiwa to add to events.

hero.badge: The event platform for planners, vendors and guests
hero.body: One place for hosts, planners, vendors and guests to plan, book, pay, run and remember the day — from a small birthday to a thousand-person conference.
hero.note: No app to install. Guests never need an account.

mock.chat: Your cake is booked for Saturday!

features.title: From first idea to the last photo
features.body: Stop juggling spreadsheets, group chats and bank screenshots. Tiwa keeps the whole event together.

plan.title: Plan with a checklist that builds itself
plan.body: Pick an event type and get tasks, timelines and a budget split ready to edit.

guests.title: Invites and RSVPs
guests.body: Share a link, track who's coming, and check guests in on the day with a QR pass.

vendors.title: Vendors and quotes
vendors.body: Compare quotes side by side, book in a tap, and keep every version in writing.

money.title: An honest budget
money.body: See planned, committed, paid and outstanding at a glance — plus pledges and income.

chat.title: Chat that keeps context
chat.body: Talk to vendors and your team in threads tied to the event and each booking.

moments.title: Moments, shared
moments.body: Guests drop photos into one gallery; the official album sits right next to it.

how.title: Four steps to a great day

one.title: Create your event
one.body: Choose the type, date and budget. Tiwa sets up the plan for you.

two.title: Bring your people
two.body: Add co-hosts and a planner with exactly the access they need.

three.title: Book vendors
three.body: Request quotes, compare, accept and track every payment.

four.title: Enjoy and remember
four.body: Run the day from your phone, then relive it in Moments.

host.title: Hosts
host.body: Plan without the stress, share the load, stay on budget.

planner.title: Planners
planner.body: Run many events and clients from one calm dashboard.

vendor.title: Vendors
vendor.body: Get real enquiries, send clear quotes, get booked.

guest.title: Guests
guest.body: RSVP, get your pass and share photos — no account needed.

vendorCta.title: Are you a vendor or venue?
vendorCta.body: List your business, answer enquiries with professional quotes and fill your calendar.

cta.title: Your next event starts here.
cta.body: Set it up in two minutes. Invite everyone else when you're ready.

market.title: Every vendor your event needs, in one place.
market.body: Browse verified venues, caterers, photographers, DJs and more. Compare quotes side by side and book with clear terms.

chat.title: Every conversation, right where the event lives.
chat.body: Message vendors, your co-hosts and your planner in threads tied to the event and each booking. Quotes, bookings and payments show up as live cards — no lost screenshots.

points.one: Read receipts and typing, in real time
points.two: Quote and booking cards that stay up to date
points.three: Contact details protected until you book
